description: Remove the page at `index`. Fails on an out-of-range index or when only one page remains — a project must keep at least one page. The active page stays active; when the active page itself is deleted, active_index falls to the neighbouring page (the one that slid into its position, or the new last page).

index.description: 0-based index of the page to remove.

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.
